mapper.sql: /* SQL ID : MsgMgrDAO.rcvrUserTycdJoin 설 명 : 사용자 구분(교수 검색) */ LEFT JOIN ( SELECT UA.USER_ID , AU.AUTHRT_CD , AU.AUTHRT_GRPCD , ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY UA.USER_ID ORDER BY AU.AUTHRT_SEQ) AS RN FROM TB_LMS_USER_AUTHRT UA INNER JOIN TB_LMS_AUTHRT AU ON AU.AUTHRT_ID = UA.AUTHRT_ID WHERE AU.AUTHRT_GRPCD != 'ADM' ) UTA ON UTA.USER_ID = U.USER_ID AND UTA.RN = 1

/* SQL ID : MsgMgrDAO.rcvrUserTycdJoinAll 설 명 : 사용자 구분(관리자 검색) */ LEFT JOIN ( SELECT UA.USER_ID , CASE WHEN AU.AUTHRT_GRPCD = 'ADM' THEN 'ADM' ELSE AU.AUTHRT_CD END AS AUTHRT_CD , AU.AUTHRT_GRPCD , ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY UA.USER_ID ORDER BY CASE WHEN AU.AUTHRT_GRPCD = 'ADM' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, AU.AUTHRT_SEQ) AS RN FROM TB_LMS_USER_AUTHRT UA INNER JOIN TB_LMS_AUTHRT AU ON AU.AUTHRT_ID = UA.AUTHRT_ID ) UTA ON UTA.USER_ID = U.USER_ID AND UTA.RN = 1

/* SQL ID : MsgMgrDAO.rcvrExcludeGuest 설 명 : 손님(AUTHRT_CD='GUEST') 권한 보유자 수신자 제외 */ AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM TB_LMS_USER_AUTHRT UAG INNER JOIN TB_LMS_AUTHRT AUG ON AUG.AUTHRT_ID = UAG.AUTHRT_ID WHERE UAG.USER_ID = U.USER_ID AND AUG.AUTHRT_CD = 'GUEST' )
mapper.select: /* SQL ID : MsgMgrDAO.selectProfSbjctOrgList 설 명 : 교수 담당과목 기준 운영 기관 목록 조회 */ SELECT ORG.* FROM ( SELECT O.* , CASE WHEN O.ORG_ID = 'ORG0000001' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END AS ODR FROM TB_LMS_ORG O WHERE O.USEYN = 'Y' AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM TB_LMS_SBJCT S INNER JOIN TB_LMS_SMSTR_CHRT SC ON SC.SMSTR_CHRT_ID = S.SMSTR_CHRT_ID INNER JOIN TB_LMS_SBJCT_ADM ADM ON ADM.SBJCT_ID = S.SBJCT_ID AND ADM.SBJCT_ADM_TYCD = 'PROF' WHERE SC.ORG_ID = O.ORG_ID AND S.DELYN = 'N' AND ADM.USER_ID = #{userId} ) ) ORG ORDER BY ODR, ORGNM

/* SQL ID : MsgMgrDAO.selectRcvrSearchList 설 명 : 받는 사람 검색 목록 조회 */
SELECT INNERQ.* , ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY INNERQ.USERNM ASC) AS LINE_NO , COUNT(*) OVER () AS TOTAL_CNT FROM ( SELECT U.USER_ID , U.USERNM , U.STDNT_NO , UTA.AUTHRT_CD AS USER_TYCD , S.SBJCTNM , (SELECT MAX(UC.CNTCT) FROM TB_LMS_USER_CNTCT UC WHERE UC.USER_ID = U.USER_ID AND UC.CNTCT_TYCD = 'MBL_PHN') AS MBL_PHN , (SELECT MAX(UC.CNTCT) FROM TB_LMS_USER_CNTCT UC WHERE UC.USER_ID = U.USER_ID AND UC.CNTCT_TYCD = 'INDV_EML') AS EML FROM TB_LMS_ATNDLC A INNER JOIN TB_LMS_SBJCT S ON A.SBJCT_ID = S.SBJCT_ID INNER JOIN TB_LMS_USER U ON A.USER_ID = U.USER_ID
WHERE S.DELYN = 'N' AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM TB_LMS_SBJCT_ADM ADM WHERE ADM.SBJCT_ID = S.SBJCT_ID AND ADM.SBJCT_ADM_TYCD = 'PROF' AND ADM.USER_ID = #{sndngrId} )
AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM TB_LMS_USER_AUTHRT UAO WHERE UAO.USER_ID = U.USER_ID AND UAO.ORG_ID = #{orgId} )
AND UTA.AUTHRT_CD != 'GUEST' GROUP BY U.USER_ID, U.USERNM, U.STDNT_NO, UTA.AUTHRT_CD, S.SBJCTNM
UNION ALL
SELECT U.USER_ID , U.USERNM , U.STDNT_NO , UTA.AUTHRT_CD AS USER_TYCD , NULL AS SBJCTNM , (SELECT MAX(UC.CNTCT) FROM TB_LMS_USER_CNTCT UC WHERE UC.USER_ID = U.USER_ID AND UC.CNTCT_TYCD = 'MBL_PHN') AS MBL_PHN , (SELECT MAX(UC.CNTCT) FROM TB_LMS_USER_CNTCT UC WHERE UC.USER_ID = U.USER_ID AND UC.CNTCT_TYCD = 'INDV_EML') AS EML FROM TB_LMS_USER U
WHERE UTA.AUTHRT_GRPCD = 'PROF' AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM TB_LMS_USER_AUTHRT UAO WHERE UAO.USER_ID = U.USER_ID AND UAO.ORG_ID = #{orgId} )
) INNERQ
ORDER BY LINE_NO

/* SQL ID : MsgMgrDAO.selectRcvrSearchAllList 설 명 : 관리자 받는 사람 검색 목록 조회 */
SELECT U.USER_ID , U.USERNM , U.STDNT_NO , UTA.AUTHRT_CD AS USER_TYCD , (SELECT MAX(UC.CNTCT) FROM TB_LMS_USER_CNTCT UC WHERE UC.USER_ID = U.USER_ID AND UC.CNTCT_TYCD = 'MBL_PHN') AS MBL_PHN , (SELECT MAX(UC.CNTCT) FROM TB_LMS_USER_CNTCT UC WHERE UC.USER_ID = U.USER_ID AND UC.CNTCT_TYCD = 'INDV_EML') AS EML , ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY U.USERNM ASC) AS LINE_NO , COUNT(*) OVER () AS TOTAL_CNT FROM TB_LMS_USER U
WHERE 1=1
ORDER BY LINE_NO

/* SQL ID : MsgMgrDAO.selectUserTycdList 설 명 : 사용자 구분 목록 조회 (받는 사람 팝업 검색조건, ADM 그룹 및 손님(GUEST) 제외 */ SELECT A.AUTHRT_CD , A.AUTHRTNM , A.AUTHRT_GRPCD FROM TB_LMS_AUTHRT A WHERE A.USEYN = 'Y' AND A.LANG_CD = 'KO' AND A.AUTHRT_GRPCD != 'ADM' AND A.AUTHRT_CD != 'GUEST' ORDER BY A.AUTHRT_GRPCD, A.AUTHRT_SEQ
